record.paper_title: Slices of Brownian Sheet: New Results, and Open Problems
record.original_question: Consider the hyperbolic stochastic PDE system (∂^2 u^i/∂t∂x) = b^i(u) + σ^i(u) · ˆB with reasonable boundary conditions, where σ: R^d → R^d is strongly elliptic, bounded, and C^∞. Do the same kinds of slice and exceptional-set results established earlier in the paper for the d-dimensional Brownian sheet also hold for solutions u of this multiplicative-noise system?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 5. Supposeσ : Rd → Rd is a strongly elliptic, bounded, C∞ func- tion. Is it the case that the results of the previous sections apply to the solution of (∂ 2ui/∂t∂x ) = bi(u) +σi(u) · ˆB with reasonable boundary conditions?
Then, as long as b := (b1,...,b d) is bounded and Borel-measurable the law of the process u := (u1,...,u d) is mutually absolutely continuous with respect to
the law of the two-parameter, d-dimensional Brownian sheet B. See Proposition 1.6 of Nualart and Pardoux [24]. Therefore, the theorems of the preceding sections apply to the process u equally well.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\hat B$ denote space-time white noise on $[0,1]^2$, i.e., the formal mixed derivative of a $d$-dimensional standard Brownian sheet $B = \{B(t,x):\,(t,x)\in[0,1]^2\}$ with values in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Consider the system of nonlinear hyperbolic stochastic partial differential equations
$$\frac{\partial^2 u^i}{\partial t\,\partial x}(t,x) \;=\; b^i(u(t,x)) \;+\; \sum_{j=1}^d \sigma^{ij}(u(t,x))\,\hat B^j(t,x), \qquad 1\le i\le d,$$
on $(t,x)\in[0,1]^2$, with reasonable (e.g., vanishing on the axes) boundary conditions, where $b:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^d$ is bounded and Borel measurable and $\sigma:\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^{d\times d}$ is bounded, $C^\infty$, and strongly elliptic (i.e., there exists $c>0$ such that $\sigma(y)\sigma(y)^\top\succeq c\,I_d$ for all $y\in\mathbb{R}^d$).

For the $d$-dimensional Brownian sheet $B$, suppose one has established results of the following form describing the geometry of its "slices" (the one-parameter processes $t\mapsto B(t,x_0)$ and $x\mapsto B(t_0,x)$ for fixed coordinates) and various exceptional-set theorems (for example, characterizations via potential theory or Hausdorff dimension of random sets where the slices exhibit prescribed exceptional behavior).

Question: Do these same slice and exceptional-set results extend, in the same form, to the solution $u=(u^1,\ldots,u^d)$ of the nonlinear multiplicative-noise system above?
artifact.status_search_result: Web search did not surface a definitive resolution of this extension to nonlinear multiplicative-noise hyperbolic SPDEs. Related developments (Dalang–Nualart potential theory for hyperbolic SPDEs; Dalang–Khoshnevisan–Nualart hitting probabilities; recent work on exceptional flat points for SPDEs) address parts of the picture but do not appear to settle in full the transfer of all slice and exceptional-set results from the Brownian sheet to solutions of the multiplicative system. Status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Potential theory for hyperbolic SPDEs
status_evidence.snippet: Dalang–Nualart develop potential theory for hyperbolic SPDEs with multiplicative noise.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress on hitting/exceptional set theory for hyperbolic SPDEs with multiplicative noise exists, but does not appear to fully resolve the transfer of all slice results.

status_evidence.title: Small-ball constants, and exceptional flat points of SPDEs
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes exceptional spatial points for stochastic heat equation with multiplicative noise.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work treats exceptional sets for multiplicative-noise SPDEs in related (parabolic) settings.
